title: Multi-state model with temporal-consistent survival analysis for homogeneous Markov chains
summary: In this study, we consider sequences drawn from time-homogeneous Markov chains and introduce a novel approach for estimating first hitting-time distributions to specified terminal states. Our method- ology is based on the temporal-consistent survival analysis that facilitates the construction of consistent estimators of the distributions from any estimates of the transition rate and transition probabilities.
